plugins.name: panma-harness
plugins.description: Multi-agent supervisor harness. Auto-dispatches role-based subagents (designer, executors, verifier, rule-applier) with Ralph loop, retry budget, and project-defined domain executors.

plugins.name: panma-hud
plugins.description: Heads-up display for Claude Code. Statusline showing model, cwd, session name, context %, 5h/7d quota utilization, session diff stats, and a 200k context warning, plus live panma-harness cycle state with a per-worker breakdown when .harness/state.json is present.
